title: Brokoli dataset schema v1
description: Language-neutral column schema for dataset values. Column types use the BPTD descriptors defined by ADR-032.

columns.description: Columns in stable output order. Column names must be unique; consumers must reject duplicate names even when descriptors differ.

additional_columns.description: Whether records may contain columns outside this declaration. unknown means the declaration is not authoritative for the complete output schema.
